query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warning_templates) as total_modelos,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_categories) as total_categorias,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warning_templates WHERE type = 'advertencia') as advertencias,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warning_templates WHERE type = 'suspensao') as suspensoes;
